title: Forums Web Application
tagline: ASP.NET MVC forum with secure auth and EF persistence
intro: University project: a forums platform with posts, comments, and role-based access.
summary: Built with C#, ASP.NET MVC, MSSQL, and Entity Framework. Implements ASP.NET Identity, secure sign-in/up, and a responsive UI. Deployed locally/IIS as coursework.

sections.title: Description
sections.body: A forums web app where users can register, create posts, and comment within role-secured areas.

sections.title: Objective / Aim
sections.body: Foster community interaction while applying best practices in auth and persistence.

sections.title: Role & Responsibilities
sections.body: Designed schema with EF, implemented MVC controllers/views, integrated ASP.NET Identity, and built the UI.

sections.title: Features / Implementation
sections.body: Secure auth flows, CRUD for posts/comments, EF migrations, Bootstrap-responsive views.

sections.title: Impact / Results
sections.body: Delivered a complete full-stack university project demonstrating backend, frontend, and database skills.
